title: Framer footer
description: A quiet black link footer: six columns of small groups (white group titles, grey links that turn white on hover, tiny "new" tags), two columns on phones, then one low row with the mark, a language picker, social icons, compliance badges, a blue-ticked status line and the copyright.
notes: columns hold groups; on phones the groups re-flow into two balanced columns
social icons come in as nodes (the demo uses @tabler/icons-react)
name: framer-footer

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name (read to screen readers by the mark)

props.name: mark
props.description: the mark in the bottom row

props.name: columns
props.description: desktop columns (six on the original), each a stack of groups

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: social links: an icon and a screen-reader label each

props.name: copyright
props.description: the copyright line on the far right
